verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt file at developers.canny.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It is titled 'Canny Developer Documentation' and covers SDK installation and widget customization, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Its depth and coverage are only partly visible, and the machine-readable OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of full llms.txt content or an llms-full.txt variant, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use of the docs.
